Mayfair CNRA:
This program is based on an expanded Mayfair target area. (Refer to Figure #7)
N: Alum Rock Avenue
E: Highway 680
S: Highway 680, rear lot line on south side of Summer Street
W: King Road
--Loans and Grants
Loans and grants will be provided only in the existing target area in the 4th year; assistance will also be available in the expanded areas in the 5th and 6th years. It is projected that 344 units will be improved over the three-year period (see Chart 2). Funding for loans and grants in this area and all neighborhood improvement areas is based on an average $8,000 loan, leveraged at 2.5 to 1. Therefore, every loan/grant will require approximately $3,200 in CDBG funds. Rehabilitation services, including technical assistance and loan processing are furnished in all neighborhood improvement areas and listed as a separate line item.
-- Mayfair Community Center
Funds have been provided for an expansion of approximately 1,000 square feet of the Mayfair Community Center on Kammerer Street. This addition will enable the center to have more room for activities for senior citizens.
